decision: test:integration is the harness; no parallel route-contract harness will be built because the suite drives the app through app.handle (Web Standard fetch), which is the same seam HttpEffect.fromWebHandler provides
uncached type-check cost recorded as the number the Effect dependency must be judged against
oxlint is not a CI gate; AGENTS.md records the pre-existing violations as separate work
effect pinned exactly at 4.0.2 rather than caret; @effect/platform-bun@4.0.3 peers effect@^4.0.3 which does not exist
override @effect/platform-node-shared to 4.0.2; ^4.0.2 resolved to 4.0.3 which peers effect@^4.0.3 and warned against the installed effect@4.0.2
Config replacement moved out of PR-01 to PR-02; its payoff needs call sites that are Effect programs, so doing it now builds a snapshot bridge later PRs delete
removed dead `declare const Bun` from the worker entry; @types/bun already supplies the global and the declare caused every import(first) violation
worker entry runs under BunRuntime.runMain with Effect.logInfo; gives SIGTERM graceful shutdown and structured failure reporting
port 3000 is shared with the taste-ui worktree dev stack and Bun binds both via SO_REUSEPORT; isolated to 3100 to avoid a contaminated baseline
taste-ui runs a worker polling the same database; bootstrapped an isolated postgres on 5544 to stop test races
gitignore the index.js.map files bun emits next to the compiled binaries
fetchWithRetry threw inside its own try, so the catch retried it; a 404 was fetched three times despite the branch that looks like it fails fast
429 fell through to the same throw and was retried with zero delay, the worst response to a rate limit
the timeout wrapped only fetch(), which resolves on headers, so a slow body was unbounded
retry policy is Schedule.exponential 200ms plus jitter, bounded by upTo times, gated on error.retryable so permanent 4xx never retries

browser pool keeps its promise surface and module-level singleton; only the busy-wait loop is replaced, with Semaphore.take, because restructuring the lifetime would change error propagation that weeb-central matches on instanceof
downloader dropped from this slice: downloadPagesToCbz writes once via Bun.write at the end, so a failed download leaves no partial file and the didFinishDownload guard is near-dead
SourceAdapter stays Promise-based; converting it would cascade into 4 server services plus the test fake, so the Effect boundary sits inside adapters/shared

effect/sql Migrator reads an empty migrations table as latest id 0 and skips every migration whose id is <= it, so a file numbered 0000 parses to id 0 and never runs on a fresh database; migration ids must start at 1

migrations stay as the existing drizzle .sql files, split on the drizzle statement-breakpoint marker and run through Statement.literal; no transcription into typed Effect migrations, so there is no chance of a mis-transcribed DDL statement
Drizzle records applied migrations in drizzle.__drizzle_migrations; the new migrator uses public.effect_sql_migrations and would see zero applied and re-run all five against existing tables
evidence: bun db:migrate on an applied database

decision: added db:adopt to seed effect_sql_migrations for a database that already has drizzle history; ids 1..5 named after the source files
replaying all five migrations on an empty database produces a schema byte-identical to the drizzle-built one
db:migrate no longer uses drizzle-kit; drizzle-kit remains only for db:generate until drizzle is removed
PR-03 left the NixOS module running drizzle-kit migrate directly, so the deployed migration path never used the new runner

deleted db:adopt and adopt-drizzle-history.ts; CI uses a fresh postgres service container and deployment is disposable, so no database anywhere carries a drizzle-applied schema that the new migrator needs told about
